analysis.headline: Shares Your Data Broadly
analysis.quote: Other members of The Walt Disney Family of Companies may access your information where they perform services on behalf of the data controllers (as data processors) and, unless prohibited under applicable law, for use on their own behalf (as data controllers) for the purposes described in this policy.

analysis.headline: Shares for Partner Marketing
analysis.quote: When you allow us to share your personal information with another company, by electing to share your personal information with carefully selected companies so that they can send you offers and promotions about their products and services;

analysis.headline: Shares for Targeted Advertising
analysis.quote: When we provide you with relevant advertising on third-party sites and applications, we may share limited personal information about you, such as certain identifiers or hashed email address, with third parties.

analysis.headline: Collects Your Precise Location
analysis.quote: Location information, including precise or approximate location information provided by a mobile or other device interacting with one of our sites, applications, or physical properties (including through beacon technologies), or associated with your IP address or other online or device identifier, where we are permitted by law to process this information;

analysis.headline: Records Your Calls
analysis.quote: Call recordings when you call our reservation centers or other guest services phone numbers.

analysis.headline: Publicly Posts Your Content
analysis.quote: If you provide personal information when you use any of these features, that personal information may be publicly posted and otherwise disclosed without limitation as to its use by us or by a third party.

analysis.headline: Tracks You Across Sites
analysis.quote: Provide you with targeted advertising based on your activity on our sites and applications and on third-party sites and applications; to learn more about how we use your information for personalization and tracking, please visit Online Tracking Technologies and Advertising .

analysis.headline: Retains Data Indefinitely
analysis.quote: We will retain your personal information for the length of time needed to fulfill the purposes outlined in this privacy policy unless a longer retention period is required or permitted by law.

analysis.headline: Third Parties Collect Your Data
analysis.quote: Please keep in mind that when you provide information to us on a third-party site or platform (for example, via our applications), the information you provide may be separately collected by the third-party site or platform.
